multiScreenGuideStep1: Each display opens in its own browser window, which the pop-up blocker stops by default. Open {{path}} and add this site under Allowed. Or, after your first Apply, click the blocked pop-up icon in the address bar and choose Always allow.
multiScreenGuideStep2: The preview shows which panels go to each display. This window is the monitor you're on now; Display 2 onward are your other monitors, left to right.
multiScreenGuideStep3: Every display opens on its own monitor with its panels loaded. If one is still blocked, its panels stay in this window until you open it.
popupSetupTitle: One-time setup: let this site open your displays
popupSetupSummary_one: Your browser blocked 1 display window. Its panels are in this window for now, so nothing is hidden.
popupSetupSummary_other: Your browser blocked {{count}} display windows. Their panels are in this window for now, so nothing is hidden.

popupSetupStep1: Click the blocked pop-up icon at the right end of the address bar.

popupSetupOnce: You only do this once in this browser. After that, every display opens on the first click.
screensPermissionHint: Showing presets for this screen only. To use your other monitors, allow window management for this site in your browser's settings, then press Detect.

reopenScreensBanner: {{count}} panels are on other screens — reopen them
removePaneHint: To remove it, use the × on the pane itself
emptyGrid: No panes on the grid — open Workspace Settings to add one.
paneUpdating: Updating — new content is on its way
dragHint: Drag the title bar to move this pane. Drag any edge or corner to resize. Other panes stay put.
resizePane: Resize pane. Use arrow keys to resize.
resizePaneFitHint: Resize pane. Use arrow keys to resize. Double-click or press Enter to fit height to content.
resizeColumns: Resize columns. Use left/right arrow keys.
resizeColumnStack: Resize stacked panes. Use up/down arrow keys.

fatalBanner: Fatal risks are open on this case.
outlookEmptyHint: An assessment appears the next time a document is added or updated on this case.
contradictionResolveHint: A real conflict you have explained or dealt with
contradictionsIntro: Statements in the record that conflict on a material fact.
noAuthorities: No authority cited for this case's grounds yet.
authorityStanceLabel: How it bears on the case
noDates: Dates extracted from the documents appear here automatically, or link a calendar event.
emptyFolder: Drop files here, or use Add above.
noSourceDocument: Source not recorded — regenerate the timeline to link it
noApproach: A recommended approach appears automatically once the case's analysis updates.
noTodos: To-dos appear automatically once the case's analysis updates, or add one below.
chatEmptySubheading: The assistant stays in this pane.
removeDocumentConfirm: Remove "{{documentName}}" from this case? This cannot be undone.
noFindings: Nothing recorded yet. Add one below — suggestions appear automatically once the case's analysis updates.
legalIssuesIntro: Open questions the tribunal will have to reach.
issueDetailPlaceholder: Who bears the burden, and on what
findingJevOff: Jev checks for this panel are turned off.
findingJevFailed: Jev couldn't check this. Try again.
issueJevBurdenDisputed: The AI draft put it on {{party}}.
llmUncertain: The AI was unsure — read the reasoning before relying on it.
llmNotReviewed: Not reviewed (the AI review failed) — this is the AI draft's rating.
llmOff: AI review is turned off for this panel.
llmFailed: The AI review couldn't run. Try again.

strengthWeightLevel.3: Carries a claim on its own

issueJevFlag.NOT_RAISED: Not found in the case data
issueJevFlag.BURDEN_DISPUTED: Burden may sit with the other side

weaknessesIntro: Exposure in our own case, ordered by how early it will surface.
weaknessImpact: Expected impact on the case (positive hurts you)

weaknessJevSupport.SUPPORTED: Borne out by the case data
weaknessJevSupport.UNSUPPORTED: Not borne out by the case data

weaknessJevCurable.NOT_CURABLE: Nothing on the record would close it

weaknessJevFlag.NOT_BORNE_OUT: Not borne out by the case data

strengthsIntro: Findings that carry our theory of the case.
strengthDetailPlaceholder: Document reference and what it shows
strengthImpact: How much of the case it carries (higher helps you)
strengthJevNoSourceText: (checked against the case data only — the document's text wasn't found)

strengthJevRebuttal.UNREBUTTED: Nothing on the record answers it
strengthJevRebuttal.REBUTTABLE: The other side has an answer you'd need to meet

attackStrategyIntro: Offensive moves to advance this case, whichever side we represent.
attackStrategyDetailPlaceholder: Why it's ready, what's left, or what's missing
defenseStrategyIntro: Defenses the other side is likely to raise against this case, and our answer to each.
defenseStrategyDetailPlaceholder: This case's answer to the defense
witnessesIntro: Statement status for the custodians named in the complaint.
witnessFactorQuoteMissing: quote not found in the document
witnessProofPrompt: Attach a document or photo from Documents that shows this was done.
witnessProofDocGone: a document no longer in Documents
witnessNotReflected: Not yet reflected in the score. Rescore to check.
witnessExtracting: Finding witnesses in your case documents…
damagesEmpty: No damages or remedies yet. Add one, or propose them from the case documents.
damageAcceptFirst: Accept this suggestion before setting its status
damageAmountHint: Leave blank for a remedy with no amount
damageAmountEstimateHint: This is an AI estimate. Change it and it becomes your figure.
damageAmountInvalid: Enter the amount as a number, or leave it blank.
damageAcceptHint: Add this AI-proposed entry to the list, so it counts in the total
damagesProposeHint: Read every document of this case again and propose damages and remedies. Entries already here are kept.
damageEstimateBasis: AI estimate — check and edit before relying on it:
damageSourceDocGone: Document no longer in this case
noWitnessesForSponsor: Add a witness in the Witnesses panel to assign a sponsor.
noReconstruction: No reconstruction yet — generate one from this case's indexed documents.
registerNotGenerated: Not generated yet — switch to General and Generate to create this version.
audioOutOfDate: Narrative changed since this audio was generated.
noRedTeam: No assessment yet — generate one from this case's Legal Issues, Weaknesses, Contradictions, Witnesses, and Damages.
redTeamArgumentsIntro: Best arguments available to {{opponent}}, ranked by expected impact.
redTeamArgumentsIntroNoParty: Best arguments available to the other side, ranked by expected impact.
redTeamImpact: Expected impact on the case (positive hurts you)
jevUncertain: Jev was unsure about this rating — read the reasoning before relying on it.
jevNotChecked: Not checked by Jev (the check failed) — this rating is the drafting AI's own.

redTeamJevSupport.SUPPORTED: the cited item supports this argument
redTeamJevSupport.UNSUPPORTED: the cited item does not establish this argument
redTeamJevSupport.CONTRADICTED: the cited item contradicts this argument

panelLibraryHint: Drag a panel onto the grid, or click to add it.
panelLibraryEmpty: All panels are already on the grid.
noDecisions: No decisions recorded yet — these populate automatically as the case's legal chat produces answers with clear conclusions.
noTheories: No theories yet — write one, or have the AI propose a starting point from this case's findings.
addClaimPlaceholder: Add a claim this theory asserts or denies
addAssumptionPlaceholder: Add an assumption this theory rests on
deleteForkedTheoryConfirm: Delete this forked theory? Its claims, assumptions, open questions and notes go with it. The original is kept.
noDiffFound: No shared or divergent claims found between these two theories.
noEvents: No event chain yet — generate the case's dated events from its documents.
eventsBlockedIntro: The event chain can't be built yet:
noScenes: No scenes yet — generate a scene-by-scene break of this case's most consequential episode from the timeline and evidence.
noTableRead: No table read yet — generate scenes first, then render a multi-voice reading of them.
tableReadOutOfDate: Scenes changed since this table read was generated.
noExhibitsForScene: No verified exhibits for this scene.
caseBriefGenerateHint: Generate a Word and PDF version of this case's brief from its current snapshot.
caseBriefRegenerateHint: Generate a fresh Word and PDF version from this case's current snapshot. Your previous briefs stay in History.
caseBriefNothingGenerated: No case brief generated yet — go to Generate first.
caseBriefFormatNotGenerated: This format hasn't been generated yet.
authorityCitationHint: Optional. We'll link the source when the citation can be found.
authorityRationaleExample: How this helps or hurts the ground
quoteExample: Paste the passage you're relying on
citedReferenceHint: Optional. Helps us find the source and link it.
officialTextExample: Paste the source passage to compare against
officialTextHint: Optional. Lets us check that your quote matches the source.
strategyStale: The case changed {{count}} time(s) since this plan was updated.
strategyStaleOne: The case changed since this plan was updated.
updatePlanFailed: The plan couldn't be updated. Try again.
recomputeSome: {{count}} couldn't be recomputed and still need attention.
approachUnsupported: Not backed by the case data
toChecklistHint: Add this as a to-do in Case Strategy
addedToChecklistHint: Already a to-do in Case Strategy. It ticks itself once this is settled.

todoAutoClosedReason.DAMAGE_EVIDENCE_IN: damage head no longer waiting on evidence
todoAutoClosedReason.DAMAGE_DONE: damages or remedy marked awarded or received

flagRiskHint: Record this in the risk register, marked unverified
traceError: The reasoning trace could not be loaded. It will retry automatically.
noTrace: No reasoning recorded yet — each answer the AI gives on this case will show here, step by step, as it is written.
noTraceForMember: No traced questions from this member yet.
traceNoSteps: The AI answered this one without running any research steps.
